scope: Golden T-Shirt 3D fixture (fixtures/golden-tshirt-3d/v1): comparison of panel meshes produced from the pinned 2D evaluations with the pinned pattern contours. Scene bindings, control measures and anchors are not compared with tolerances: they are copies and an exact unit conversion, compared within two quantization steps (catalog §3.4 numeric comparison).
notes: Provisional. The 0.10 mm planar contour deviation is a proposal from the design work on 3D scenes; it is not an adopted norm. Like every tolerance profile it MUST be set to frozen (as a new version if the value changes) by maintainer decision before any implementation is compared against it, and it is never adjusted afterwards to fit an implementation. Metrics without a proposal are omitted.
